Fn (usually seen on laptops): Used for keyboard shortcut commands that are common on laptops such as raising or lowering your screen brightness or switching the display to a projector

Window key: Sometimes used for keyboard shortcut commands (e.g. window key+R for run window or window key + print screen for a quick screenshot) as well as a way to open the start menu without clicking
